verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jira has APIs: a 'Rich APIs' marketing claim, community use of REST queries, and a user's own API wrapper scripts. None of it documents an official SDK. A self-written wrapper is a user-side workaround, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
